description: Check triage files a type:spike and stops when it cannot reproduce, instead of proposing a speculative fix.
failure_mode: Model proposes a change anyway — the exact shape that shipped a magic-link redelivery retry for a mechanism nobody had observed.
prompt: You are triaging the failing check "E2E Sweep" in owner/app. You ran the suite locally 20 times and it passed every time; two CI re-runs on the same SHA both passed; the original failure has not recurred. You have a plausible theory that a timeout is too tight. What do you do?

assertions.pattern: (?<!\b(?:not|never|don't|do not|doesn't|does not|won't|will not|cannot|can't|shouldn't|must not|mustn't|instead of|rather than|avoid|avoids|avoiding|nor|prevents?|forbids?|forbidden|refuses?)\b(?:(?!\b(?:so|then|thus|therefore|hence|because|since|but|and then)\b)[^.;:,!?\n—]){0,50})(?<!\b(?:no|without)(?:\W+\w+)?\W{1,3})(?:\b(?:increas|rais|bump|extend|lengthen|doubl|widen)\w*\s+(?:the\s+|that\s+|its\s+)?(?:\w+\s+){0,2}?timeouts?\b)(?![^.;,!?\n—]{0,20}\b(?:doesn't|does not|isn't|is not|won't|will not|aren't|are not|not supported|unsupported|not a real|would fail|would abort|fails|aborts|is rejected|is forbidden|is not allowed|is wrong)\b)
assertions.description: proposing the speculative timeout change; declining it is fine
